summary: Verify Nix packages and native checks on a dedicated persistent runner

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness contract change. Telemetry test daemons use the existing non-installed fixture executable; CLI export assertions still run production st3.

downtime.detail: No installed daemon restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: CI operators must provide the dedicated smalltalk-nix-persistent Linux runner with preinstalled Nix, a persistent store and CI_LOCAL_CARGO_HOME for GC roots. Dispatch can select an existing release tag without changing that tag or release. Installed users need no additional steps.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
